title: Aspirational Affordances of AI
findings: When prompted to visualize a future for Iranian schoolgirls involved in the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement, the AI system (DALL-E) produced images that ignored the protestors' aspirations for social and political transformation (e.g., the removal of mandatory hijab laws). Instead, it consistently generated technologically advanced futures where current socio-political and religious norms remained unchanged, effectively erasing and sidelining the core aspirations for social change.

measurement_description: The paper does not present a formal benchmark. It conducts a case study analyzing how an AI image generator (DALL-E) represents a future scenario involving a group (Iranian schoolgirls) protesting state-enforced religious/political norms (mandatory hijab). The analysis focuses on the AI's tendency to erase aspirations for social and political change related to these norms, while defaulting to depictions of technological advancement.
